gaps.explanation: The whole filing is one page (2025 Audit Waiver Request, p1) with a single 'Total of All Funds' column; no fund column is printed. Receipts printed there: State Receipts 14,577.31, Local Receipts 7,651.47, Local Receipts -- Interest 102.21 (= 22,330.99). The rule allows detail lines only from fund columns, never the Total column, so nothing can be added. Needs a user ruling on whether single-column waiver forms may use the Total of All Funds column (it would tie exactly: 14,577.31 + 7,651.47 + 102.21 = 22,330.99).

Same single 'Total of All Funds' column (p1): Operating Expenses 8,561.91 + Remittance to County Treasurer 40,979.04 = 49,540.95. No fund column printed; Total column not allowed. Needs a user ruling (would tie exactly).
p1 line 15 Transfers Between Funds In 26,804.97, printed only in the 'Total of All Funds' column; the Inter-fund Transfers From/To boxes are blank, so no fund can be named. Nothing added.
p1 line 24 Transfers Between Funds Out 26,804.97, printed only in the 'Total of All Funds' column; the From/To boxes are blank. Nothing added.
